id: W:stein|origens e evolucao da industria textil no brasil
original_title: The Brazilian cotton manufacture: textile enterprise in an underdeveloped area, 1850-1950
note: The 1979 Campus edition is the Portuguese translation of The Brazilian Cotton Manufacture; the bibliography explicitly identifies the original title.

original_title: Cidadania e direitos do trabalho
note: Separate Zahar book, published in October 2002; none of the supplied Gomes works is this title. ISBN confirmed by the publisher.

original_title: Le mythe aryen: essai sur les sources du racisme et des nationalismes
note: Portuguese translation by Luiz João Gaio. Prefer the 1971 French original to the candidate English translation, The Aryan Myth.

id: W:passos|em torno da historia de sabara
original_title: Em torno da história de Sabará
note: Zoroastro Vianna Passos's work, first volume published by SPHAN in 1940; a second followed in 1942. Museum library catalogue confirms the work. No LCCN, ISBN or OCLC number verified.

original_title: Eros and civilization: a philosophical inquiry into Freud
note: Portuguese translation of Eros and Civilization, documented in the author's official bibliography.

original_title: Labouring men: studies in the history of labour
note: Os trabalhadores: estudos sobre a história do operariado translates Labouring Men. The 1984 Workers/Worlds of Labour candidates are a different collection.

original_title: The uses of literacy: aspects of working-class life, with special reference to publications and entertainments
note: The 1973 Portuguese translation of The Uses of Literacy. The supplied English candidate has the American subtitle; prefer it to the French translation candidate.

original_title: A cidade como espetáculo: publicidade e vida urbana na São Paulo dos anos 20
note: Márcia Padilha's Annablume book; UFMG library confirms the 2001 edition and ISBN. Google Books dates its record 2000. No candidates supplied.

original_title: Cantos populares do Brazil
note: The 1985 Itatiaia/EDUSP edition of Sílvio Romero's 1883 collection, with modernized title spelling. The appended author names in the citation are extraneous.

id: W:hespanha|direito luso brasileiro no antigo regime
original_title: Direito luso-brasileiro no Antigo Régime
note: Cited as a separate Florianópolis: Fundação Boiteux, 2005 book. No supplied title is established as the same work. No identifier confirmed in a library or publisher record; leave identifiers blank.

original_title: Danças dramáticas do Brasil
note: Brazilian Mário de Andrade (1893-1945), posthumously edited by Oneyda Alvarenga; first published in 1959. Library confirms the cited 1982 second edition and ISBN. Candidate corpus belongs to the Angolan namesake.

id: W:baer|industrializacao e o desenvolvimento economico do brasil
original_title: Industrialization and economic development in Brazil
note: Portuguese translation and later edition of the 1965 book. CiNii records the English original title; The Brazilian Economy is a separate candidate title.

original_title: A experiência etnográfica: antropologia e literatura no século XX
note: Portuguese selection organized by José Reginaldo Santos Gonçalves, drawing essays from The Predicament of Culture and Writing Culture. It is not a complete translation of either candidate. Google Books dates the selection 1998; UFG library confirms the ISBN in its 2008 edition record.

original_title: Macunaíma: o herói sem nenhum caráter
note: Novel by Brazilian Mário de Andrade (1893-1945), first published in 1928. Candidate corpus belongs to the Angolan namesake. IFMG library confirms ISBN of the 1997 Villa Rica edition.

original_title: Em nome da liberdade: as vilas de índios do Rio Grande do Norte sob o diretório pombalino no século XVIII
container: Doctoral thesis, História do Norte-Nordeste, Universidade Federal de Pernambuco, Recife, 2005, 699 f.
note: The 2005 item is Fátima Martins Lopes's doctoral thesis, not a commercial book. The required kind vocabulary lacks thesis, so book is used as a long-form placeholder. No requested identifier verified; institutional repository identifies the thesis.

original_title: Cartografia das Minas Gerais: da capitania à província
note: The title field contains only et al. Most likely Antônio Gilberto Costa and collaborators' 2002 UFMG cartographic publication, confirmed in the university library bulletin. This is a provisional identification from author/year; no identifier verified.

id: W:moore jr|as origens sociais da ditadura e da democracia
original_title: Social origins of dictatorship and democracy: lord and peasant in the making of the modern world
note: Portuguese translation of Barrington Moore Jr.'s 1966 Beacon Press book. No candidates supplied. Original edition's LCCN confirmed in the University of Texas law library catalogue.

id: W:carrara|receitas e despesas da real fazenda no brasil
original_title: Receitas e despesas da Real Fazenda no Brasil, século XVIII: Minas Gerais, Bahia, Pernambuco
note: The eighteenth-century volume, not Carrara's separate seventeenth-century volume also published in 2009. Publisher catalogue confirms ISBN, year, 284 pages and coverage of Minas Gerais, Bahia and Pernambuco.

original_title: Culture and practical reason
note: Portuguese translation of the 1976 University of Chicago Press book. Neither Stone Age Economics nor Islands of History is the same work. Original edition's LCCN confirmed in CiNii Books.

original_title: As redes clientelares
container: História de Portugal, vol. 4: O Antigo Regime (1620-1807), coordinated by António Manuel Hespanha, directed by José Mattoso, 1993, pp. 381-393
note: Parsing shifted the chapter's container into cited_title. The author field preserves As redes clientelares and its coauthor Hespanha. Xavier's institutional bibliography confirms this chapter; match its own candidate, not the whole volume.
